doc: Stage analysis (Stan Weinstein, Secrets for Profiting in Bull and Bear Markets, Dow Jones-Irwin 1988). On the weekly chart the 30-week moving average and volume classify four stages: stage 1, a base, price flat around a flat average; stage 2, the advance, price breaks above the average on expanding volume and the average turns up (the buy stage); stage 3, the top, price chops around a flattening average; stage 4, the decline, price below a falling average (avoid or sell). This preset draws the 150-day SMA (30 weeks of five days) on daily bars and a volume pane. Weinstein's Mansfield relative strength, the stock against a benchmark index (a zero line, positive when the stock leads), is not drawn: a chart takes one set of bars and has no benchmark series.
